notes: Synchronized calibration: Start Calibration on this page or on the touch screen opens the same guided session on both (zeroing, then Place Calibration Weight with Confirm / Cancel, measuring, saving). The first Confirm from either side wins and the other popup follows; the new factor is shown only after the scale has saved, read back and verified it, and the previous calibration is kept on any failure.
